findings.title: The three notes leave out what an owner checks first, so the trial button asks them to act on trust

location.description: the three notes under the hero, starting with 'Works with your till'

findings.viewer_experience: An owner reads 'Works with your till' and 'Orders from your distributor' and cannot tell if their own till, card reader or distributor is supported, or who handles returns. So 'Start a 30-day trial' asks them to act on trust.

current.value: The notes say 'Works with your till', 'Orders from your distributor' and 'Returns are tracked for you'. They name no till, card reader or distributor, do not say who tracks returns, and give no comparison with how the owner works now.

findings.target: The notes name the supported tills and card readers, the distributors that get reorder lists, who tracks returns, and give one comparison with how the owner works now. The maker must supply these facts; do not invent them.
findings.fix_direction: The maker supplies the supported tills and card readers, the distributors that get reorder lists, who tracks returns, and one comparison with how the owner works now. Then edit the notes so 'Returns are tracked for you' says who tracks them. Do not invent these facts; only the maker has them.

closed_when.check: In the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images, a fresh critic sees the notes name the supported tills, card readers and distributors, say who tracks returns, and give one comparison with how the owner works now.

findings.title: Notes 1 and 2 run 44 and 40 characters per line, under the 45 asked for

location.description: the first and second notes under the hero

findings.viewer_experience: The note lines run a little shorter than the 45 characters per line the crit asks for.
findings.target: at least 45 characters per line in notes 1 and 2
findings.fix_direction: Narrow the gap between the note columns a little if the maker wants the number met.

closed_when.check: characters_per_line of section.facts > p:nth-of-type(1) and section.facts > p:nth-of-type(2) in the desktop and widescreen viewports is 45 or more
